grid.projection: Web Mercator pixel grid (cell centres at x0+j+0.5, y0+i+0.5 global pixels)

dem_water.note: Flat water surface recorded in the elevation data (SRTM, February 2000). Vertical datum EGM96; the published levels use the national height system, so offsets of the order of a metre are possible.

dam.note: Cells of the dam body (within the radius and at or above this elevation) cannot be flooded or crossed.

elevation.name: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen/Tilezen) on AWS Open Data, zoom 11; SRTM (NASA/USGS) in this region
elevation.licence: SRTM: public domain; attribution per Tilezen

precipitation.name: NASA POWER climatology, PRECTOTCORR (MERRA-2 based)
precipitation.period: 25-year Meteorological and Solar Monthly & Annual Climatologies (January 2001 - December 2025)
precipitation.note: One 0.5° × 0.625° grid cell over the reservoir; rain on the lake only, not the catchment.

published.citation: OSHPC Barki Tojik / Coyne et Bellier, ELC Electroconsult, IPA (2014). Techno-Economic Assessment Study for Rogun Hydroelectric Construction Project, Phase II, Vol. 3, Chapter 5: Reservoir Operation Study (report P.002378 RP 40), published by the World Bank.

storage_law.note: Fitted to 1991–2011 operation records; an average law for that period. The report states an active storage of 4.2 km3; the law with these rounded parameters gives 4.50 km3 between 857 and 910 m.

evaporation_mm_per_month.where: Table 2.6, p. 18 (from the designer's report; one table is given for Rogun and Nurek)

capacity_surveys_km3.note: The report calls the differences between surveys doubtful and the present volume not well known.

land_cover.name: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200
land_cover.attribution: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium
land_cover.method: Each elevation cell (about 60 m) takes the most frequent class of the 10 m WorldCover pixels whose centres fall inside it.
